TMX Group (X) has priced a C$1.1B private placement of senior unsecured debentures to accredited investors in Canada.
The offering comprises C$250M of 3.862% Series K debentures due September 2028, C$400M of 4.571% Series L debentures due September 2033, and C$450M of 4.904% Series M debentures due September 2036.
TMX Group expects the offering to close on September 22.
Net proceeds will be used to repay a portion of outstanding indebtedness and for general corporate purposes.

title: TMX Group prices C$1.1B debt offering across three maturities
